dedupe_keys.name: uav and ground measurements dataset of 5g millimeter wave signal strength and quality

description: Junaid Sajid and colleagues publish spatial measurements from an operational 5G New Radio Standalone network on the Tallinn University of Technology campus in Estonia. More than 300,000 timestamped samples describe synchronisation-signal-block beams, signal strength and quality, geographic coordinates and altitude. Measurements use a Rohde & Schwarz scanner and downconverter carried by a UAV or during ground and rooftop walking tests. The UAV is a measurement platform; the records describe the telecommunications network. Multiple radio units operate in the n258 millimetre-wave band. The source identifies propagation analysis, beam behaviour, radio-environment mapping and data-driven wireless-system modelling as intended uses. CSV files contain UTC timestamp, location, physical cell identity, SSB index and RSSI, SSB-RSSI, SS-RSRP, SS-SINR and SS-RSRQ indicators. Missing metadata include measurement dates, sampling interval and positional accuracy. Repository files are restricted. The Research Use License requires owner approval for academic or research use and prohibits copying, modification, redistribution and commercial use. Charges are not stated. No files or permissions were obtained. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
